name: element.invoke
description: Invoke the InvokePattern on the given element (analogous to a click for buttons, links, menu items).

handle.description: Element handle in `elt:N` form, sourced from element.list / find / at / tree.

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`.

x-implementations.name: uia_invoke
x-implementations.description: UIA `IUIAutomationInvokePattern::Invoke`. Returns ERR not_supported_by_target if the element doesn't expose InvokePattern (e.g. plain text labels); ERR target_gone if the underlying element was destroyed since allocation.

windows-modern.description: InvokePattern.Invoke. The most universally-supported UIA pattern; works on Buttons, MenuItems, Hyperlinks, ListItems, etc. Bypasses synthetic input — no UIPI / focus concerns.

windows-classic.description: An element with no default-action string (static text, panes) gives `ERR not_supported_by_target` without being called. Otherwise any success code is OK, `S_FALSE` included: MSHTML returns `S_FALSE` from a default action that did run. Disconnect-type failures give `ERR target_gone`, `E_ACCESSDENIED` gives `ERR permission_denied`. Note that a list item's default action is usually a double-click, which also confirms its dialog. Shared MSAA rules (roles, tree shape, hidden elements, hung windows, handle limits): PROTOCOL.md §10.7.
